mentions.name: Saint Beluga
mentions.description: A Christian apologetics website publishing in-depth articles and interviews to help fellow engineers, scientists, and mathematicians seek answers to life's deepest questions. Content includes medical miracles recognized at Lourdes (2018-2025), an interview with three-time Putnam Fellow and IMO gold medalist Evan O'Dorney, a scientific overview of Eucharistic miracles, and a conversion testimony from Harvard astronomy professor Karin Oberg.
